text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"The evidence on whether remote work increases productivity is mixed rather than uniformly positive.","cited_pids":[]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Some sources report that remote work can be as productive as office work, or more so.","cited_pids":["7e0a814b280e#5"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"Remote work enhanced digital product innovation at the team level in one source.","cited_pids":["365d3a2f178e#2"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A randomized trial found fully remote work raised measured performance by 13% in a call-center setting.","cited_pids":["e6c79bb09406#0"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"In the randomized trial, fully remote work lowered performance for collaborative IT professionals.","cited_pids":["e6c79bb09406#0"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"A study of software developers found hybrid work outperformed fully remote work.","cited_pids":["75d059a76843#1"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"In the software developer study, productivity rose with the number of days worked in the office.","cited_pids":["75d059a76843#1"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"A Japanese study associated full-time remote work with reduced work productivity.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"The Japanese study also found full-time remote work increased presenteeism.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]},{"cid":"c10","text":"Conscientiousness is linked to higher self-reported productivity when working from home.","cited_pids":["44ecc13330bd#0"]}]}
